02/10/2025
Claim opened after the claimant reported being rear-ended while stopped at a traffic light. The claimant is not
represented by counsel, and I explained the claims process and what documents will be needed.
02/27/2025
Spoke with the other driver, who confirmed the vehicles made contact in the manner the claimant described. Photos
taken at the scene are consistent with that account, and two independent witnesses gave matching statements.
03/11/2025
Reviewed the police report, whcih places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. The damage to the
rear of the claimant's car appears largely in line with the impact described, and I found no record of earlier damage to
the vehicle.
04/19/2025
Confirmed with the policyholder's records that the driver inovlved is a member of the household and is covered under
the policy. The loss date falls within the active coverage period, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates
the policy start.
05/16/2025
Claimant reports a knee injury from the impact. The reported injury is plausible for a rear-end collision of this kind,
and the claimant has no known prior injury to that area.
05/27/2025
Treatment has followed a typical course, with visits tapering as the claimant's knee improved. The claimant has given
the same account of the accident in every conversation so far.
08/09/2025
Reviewed the treatment records and medical bills against the expected recovery timeline. The care provided is
reasnoable for the injury reported, and no further action is needed beyond routine closure documentation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
